visual_identity.core_identity: A dead ogre animated into a slow hulking corpse, preserving huge ogre proportions while showing restrained unmistakable undeath.
visual_identity.silhouette: Massive slumped giant with drooping shoulders, uneven gait, and thick heavy limbs.
visual_identity.head_features: Broad ogre face with sunken eyes, slack jaw, and damaged but recognizable features without graphic gore.
visual_identity.body_shape: Huge heavy ogre frame with sagging posture, stiff joints, and asymmetrical undead movement.
visual_identity.surface: Sparse torn skin and a few simplified corpse marks; never dense gore or decay texture.
signature_gear: simple broken restraints or torn wraps

accuracy_checks: reads as ogre and zombie simultaneously
